seo_description: MEVCO focuses on baby and maternal care, personal care, supplements, wellness and future consumer healthcare categories.
p_01: We are building a selective consumer-health portfolio that meets needs across family care, personal care and wellbeing.
p_02: Baby hygiene, practical infant-care accessories, feeding support and selected maternal-care products.
p_03: Family hygiene, personal-care essentials, skin and sensitive-care products.
p_04: Selected nutritional and wellness categories, contingent on all necessary local approvals and product documentation.
p_05: Potential future pharmaceutical and OTC product categories, subject to regulatory eligibility, licensing and operational readiness.
p_06: We prioritize distinctive products, credible manufacturers, sustainable pricing and the potential for long-term retailer demand.
